Search visibility: 30 queries re-checked plus the 5 new derived queries first-checked = 35 SERP samples on 2026-06-12. Same dedicated-URL pattern as items #25, #32, #34 — a competitor has just demonstrated suburb-targeted dedicated URLs work even from a non-osteo (physio) site. Priority drops 25 → 15. NOTABLE POSITIVE: `paediatric osteopath christchurch` AI summary continues to name Nina Hu directly (via happyspine.co.nz/nina-hu position 7) — entity attribution layer remains active two weeks running. First-check observations from the 5 new derived queries: (a) `acupuncture for endometriosis christchurch` — Burwood Acupuncture has a dedicated `/blog/endometriosis-christchurch-fertility-support` blog post and House of Acupuncture has TWO endometriosis URLs in top 10 (the #14 blog-velocity pattern continues); aldebaranhealing.co.nz is a new West Melton competitor we hadn't seen before. (b) `acupuncture for pcos christchurch` — hollow specialty SERP: no Christchurch clinic has a dedicated PCOS sub-page, House of Acupuncture mentions PCOS only within their women's-health page. STRONG content-gap opportunity for a Min Jin sub-page given PR #98 listed PCOS as her new special interest. (c) `acupuncture for cancer christchurch` — hollow specialty SERP: no Christchurch clinic has a dedicated cancer-acupuncture sub-page; Koru Healing's ACC page just mentions it. STRONG content-gap opportunity for a Min Jin post-cancer supportive-care sub-page. (d) `headaches osteopath christchurch` — same SERP shape as the combined `headaches migraines` query (Better Health + osteopath-christchurch.com blog velocity). (e) `post concussion syndrome christchurch` — DIFFERENT competitive set (Axis Sports Medicine concussion clinic, Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy, headachetendon.nz CFR) — symptom-focused query brings in PCS specialty clinics, not osteos at all. Confirms intent splits — a future concussion page (item #32) would need explicit post-concussion-syndrome symptom language to compete on this variant. Three queries pruned this run (`acupuncture vs dry needling` — non-NZ authority sites win, FAQ schema not picked up after 26 days; `dry needling halswell` — hollow suburb+modality pattern, single NZ slot for 5+ runs; `osteopath cashmere` — Cashmere Osteo locks the suburb-name SERP, not winnable). Three new derived queries added: `low level laser therapy christchurch` (Jonathan's distinctive specialty — tests whether a hyper-niche modality query is winnable), `massage therapist christchurch` (Min Jin's new dual role per PR #98 — tests whether her massage offering gets indexed), `chronic pain osteopath christchurch` (natural intent variant; Jonathan treats this). Standard −10 decay applied across all 30 queries below top 10. Pool size 45/50.

Industry signals (week of 2026-06-05 → 2026-06-12): (1) **GSC Generative AI report rollout is UK-first.** Google confirmed (developers.google.com/search/blog/2026/06/gen-ai-performance-reports) that initial access is limited to a subset of UK website owners before broader global rollout; no click, CTR or query data yet — visibility only. Updates item #35: the verification action (account access + opt-in toggle check) still applies, but realistic data availability for meridianosteopathy.co.nz may slip several weeks past the original 2026-06-17 opt-out toggle date. (2) **llms.txt practical reality study (500M+ LLM bot traffic events).** GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, OAI-SearchBot, and Google-Extended overwhelmingly SKIP /llms.txt — they crawl HTML directly. Healthcare/legal/financial verticals show <10% adoption among top-100 domains overall, and SE Ranking sample of 300k domains shows 10.13% total adoption. Implication: Meridian's existing llms.txt + llms-full.txt + `<link rel='alternate'>` are still worth keeping (zero ongoing maintenance cost, signal of intent, future-proofs against any future Anthropic/OpenAI adoption announcement) but should NOT be a focus area for more investment. The schema-impact study from last week + this llms.txt-skip study together close out two of the three 'add more AEO-specific markup' levers — only content depth/freshness (item #14) remains. (3) **Ahrefs 55.8M AI Overviews analysis.** Citation overlap with organic top-10 dropped 76% (mid-2025) → 38% (early 2026); list-formatted pages cited 67% more than equivalent prose (validates item #34 shipped last week); direct-answer openings + E-E-A-T signals do the work, not domain authority. Reinforces #14, #31, #34 patterns. (4) **GBP photo signal emerging.** Multiple local-SEO sources this week (mapranks, healthcaresuccess) flag that contextually labelled GBP photos (treatment rooms, exterior, practitioner headshots labelled by name + role) influence AI Overview inclusion for local healthcare. Drives NEW item #36 — GBP photo audit. Same pattern as #21 (GBP services audit, shipped) — owner-side action, no code changes. (5) **GBP review-recency window tightened.** Reviews within the last 30 days improve rankings by up to 15% vs profiles that have gone quiet; AI Overviews now trigger on 83% of all queries (was 88% for healthcare specifically last week). Reinforces #13, #16. (6) **Wikipedia 47.9% of ChatGPT top-cited domains, Reddit 46.7% of Perplexity.** 23.6M Reddit pages cited across AI engines, appearing in 92.8% of all AI search opportunities. Reddit citation share has stabilised — reinforces #15. Tier 1 → #35 (deadline 2026-06-17 still applies for toggle, UK rollout may push data availability later). Tier 2 → #12, #13, #25, #32, #36. Tier 3 → #14, #15, #16.

gaps.title: No blog / editorial content
gaps.why: Freshness cliff at ~3 months. April-2026 industry data: 76.4% of ChatGPT's top-cited pages were updated within 30 days, 50% of Perplexity citations come from content less than 13 weeks old. osteopath-christchurch.com is winning headache/migraine/cranial/baby-osteo/arthritis queries on blog-post velocity — 1 short post per condition is enough to claim those niches. MK Osteopathy is doing the same for TMJ and tennis elbow. Reinforced 2026-06-12: Ahrefs 55.8M AI Overviews study confirmed citation overlap with organic top-10 dropped from 76% (mid-2025) to 38% (early 2026) — direct-answer openings + freshness + list format do the work, not domain authority. The two structural counterweights to schema-heavy AEO advice (last week's Ahrefs schema-impact study + this week's 500M-event llms.txt-skip study) together close out 'add more markup' as a competing investment lever; content depth + freshness is the only one still doing work. Per local-SEO data, content updated within the past two months earns 28% more AI citations than older material. New 2026-06-12 confirmation: hollow specialty SERPs for 'acupuncture for pcos christchurch' and 'acupuncture for cancer christchurch' (no clinic has a dedicated sub-page — first short post per niche would likely claim them, same blog-velocity pattern that osteopath-christchurch.com proves week after week).

gaps.title: No off-site citation strategy
gaps.why: Reddit appears in 46.5%–46.7% of Perplexity citations (stable as of week of 2026-06-12; multiple sources triangulate) and ~5% of ChatGPT citations. Reddit is the second most visible website in Google search results in 2026 (only Wikipedia ahead) and is now the most-cited social domain across AI models — 23.6M Reddit pages cited across AI engines, appearing in 92.8% of all AI search opportunities (2026 analysis of 680M citations across 5 platforms). Tinuiti Q1 2026 data: social-media share of AI citations climbed past 9% Oct-2025 → Jan-2026, with Reddit accounting for the dominant share of that growth across nine product categories. Wikipedia counter-weight: 47.9% of ChatGPT's top-cited source share — Wikipedia is the gatekeeper for ChatGPT in the same way Reddit is for Perplexity. ClaudeBot crawl volume grew 800% at the start of 2026 — Reddit citations are increasingly the path into Claude's answers too, not just Perplexity's. Item #15 still applies.

items.title: Add speakable blocks on service intros
items.body: Add schema.org speakable specification on service intro paragraphs for voice assistants / Gemini Live. With the citation-ready 40–60 word answers now in place (item #31 shipped 2026-05-17), wrapping them in a speakable block is the natural follow-up — gives voice assistants a single span to read aloud rather than guessing. NOTE 2026-06-12: still de-prioritised — last week's Ahrefs schema-impact study (1,885 pages adding JSON-LD vs 4,000 controls, no major uplift in citations) plus this week's 500M-event llms.txt-skip study close out 'more markup' as a meaningful investment lever. Speakable remains cheap to ship but is a Tier-2-Impact-L item, not a focus area.

items.title: Auto-fetch Google Business Profile reviews at build time
items.body: So reviewCount / ratingValue stay current without manual edits. Build script hits Places API with a 24h cache. Reinforced 2026-06-12: GBP review-recency window tightened in this week's local-SEO data — reviews within the last 30 days improve rankings by up to 15% vs profiles that have gone quiet, and AI Overviews now trigger on 83% of all queries. GBP review patterns / sentiment / response activity feed directly into AI Overview generation for local-business answers per multiple sources this week (mapranks, healthcaresuccess, mooretechsolutions). Combined with #16 (review-nudge email) this closes the GBP review-recency loop end to end.

items.title: Start a blog (2 posts/month)
items.body: Short evidence-based articles per condition. Each post: author byline with Physician schema, datePublished, dateModified, 3–5 FAQs. Ahrefs analysis of 17M AI citations (April 2026) found AI-cited content is 25.7% fresher than traditional Google organic results — 76.4% of ChatGPT's top-cited pages were updated within the last 30 days. Freshness compounds. Confirmed week after week: osteopath-christchurch.com owns headaches/cranial/baby/teeth-grinding/stress/arthritis queries on the strength of one short blog post per condition; MK Osteopathy does the same for TMJ and tennis elbow; Burwood Acupuncture now owns 'acupuncture for endometriosis christchurch' with a single dated blog post (first observed 2026-06-12). STRONGEST CASE YET 2026-06-12: the two 'more markup' counterweights are now closed out — Ahrefs schema-impact study (Aug 2025–Mar 2026, no AI-citation uplift) plus this week's 500M-event llms.txt-skip study (GPTBot/ClaudeBot/PerplexityBot/OAI-SearchBot/Google-Extended overwhelmingly skip the file and crawl HTML directly). Content depth + freshness is the only remaining lever. Hollow specialty SERPs this week ('acupuncture for pcos christchurch', 'acupuncture for cancer christchurch') confirm that no Christchurch competitor has staked the dedicated-sub-page or dedicated-blog-post for these niches yet — the first short post per niche would likely claim them. With /admin Decap CMS coverage filled (PR #91), the editorial path is shorter than it was — adding a Decap blog collection would let the clinic publish without code changes.

items.title: Seed Reddit / community brand mentions
items.body: Genuine, non-spammy answers on r/newzealand / r/chch / r/AskNZ threads about osteopathy, ACC claims, back pain. Reddit is 46.5%–46.7% of Perplexity citations (stable week of 2026-06-12 across multiple sources), ~5% of ChatGPT citations, and the second most visible site in Google results overall (Wikipedia first). 2026 analysis of 680M citations across 5 AI platforms: Reddit ranked #1 cited source across every major AI engine, with 23.6M pages cited in AI responses and a 92.8% appearance rate in AI search opportunities. Tinuiti Q1 2026 data: social-media share of AI citations climbed past 9% Oct-2025 → Jan-2026 with Reddit accounting for the dominant share of that growth. Conductor research note: when LLMs cite Reddit, sole-source citations rose 31%. ClaudeBot scaled 800% at start of 2026 — Reddit is increasingly the path into Claude's answers too. 90/10 rule: 90% non-promotional, 2–4 weeks of karma-building before any mention of Meridian.

items.title: Encourage monthly Google reviews nudge
items.body: Post-consultation email nudge via Resend (already wired). AI engines prefer reviews under 12 months old. Reinforced 2026-05-02: Google's March 2026 core update now weights review recency AND owner response rate more heavily than raw count. Healthcare best-practice = at least 1 new review/week. May-2026 PinMeTo data: GBP is the primary data source for AI-driven local search across Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT and Perplexity location queries. Reinforced 2026-06-12: review-recency window tightened — fresh reviews from the last 30 days improve rankings by up to 15% vs quiet profiles; businesses responding to 80%+ of reviews see a 10–20% ranking boost; AI Overviews now trigger on 83% of all queries. Combined with #13 (auto-fetch reviews at build time), this closes the GBP review-recency loop end to end.

items.title: Enable Google Search Console Generative AI performance report before opt-out toggle goes live
items.body: Google launched a dedicated Generative AI performance report in Search Console on 2026-06-03 that tracks impressions for AI Overviews and AI Mode, broken down by pages, countries, devices and dates at hourly through monthly granularity. The opt-out toggle takes effect 2026-06-17 — sites are opted IN by default until then, after which an admin can disable AI-surface reporting. UPDATE 2026-06-12: Google has confirmed (developers.google.com/search/blog/2026/06/gen-ai-performance-reports) that the report is rolling out UK-first to a subset of website owners before broader global rollout, with no click / CTR / query data yet (impressions only). Implications for Meridian: (a) the verification + toggle-check action below still applies and the 2026-06-17 toggle date still matters because once flipped no future change resurrects historical AI-surface impressions; (b) real data availability for meridianosteopathy.co.nz (NZ property) likely slips several weeks past the UK launch; (c) no clicks / CTR / query data limits what we can conclude even when the report lands. This is still the first first-party way to measure AI-search visibility at all (citation overlap with organic top-10 collapsed to 17–38% post-Gemini-3, so traditional rank tracking misses the majority of the AI-surface story). Action items unchanged: (1) verify the clinic's GSC account has meridianosteopathy.co.nz as a verified property, (2) before 2026-06-17 check the AI Overviews / AI Mode toggle is left ON (default), (3) once the report becomes available for NZ, screenshot the first two weeks of baseline data to bank a 'pre-blog' reading before item #14 ships.

Specifically: treatment-room interiors with what-you-see captions ('Treatment room at Meridian Osteopathy, Hillmorton — adjustable plinth, soft lighting, accessible from street level'), exterior shots ('100 Sparks Road, Hillmorton — accessible entrance'), and practitioner headshots labelled by name + role + key clinical interest ('Min Jin — Acupuncturist & Massage Therapist — women's health & post-cancer supportive care'). Same owner-side pattern as item #21 (GBP services audit, shipped 2026-04-26) — no code changes, no repo changes, just owner login to business.google.com → Photos. Action items: (1) audit current GBP photo set, (2) replace any generic stock-feel images with what's actually visible at the Hillmorton clinic, (3) add or update descriptive caption text on every photo to include the clinic name, location, and what the photo shows or who's in it (practitioner name + role for headshots), (4) ensure all four current practitioners (Nina, Jonathan, Min, Kaylee) have a labelled headshot. Reinforces and extends the entity-disambiguation work of items #27 (IndividualPhysician schema), #28 (descriptive alt text) and the live signal that 'paediatric osteopath christchurch' AI summary names Nina by full email + phone — labelled images give the same AI surfaces another entity-confirming signal on the Maps / Local axis.
